meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跨多个生物信息学数据库统一查询与分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在单个工作流中统一访问多个生物数据库（如UniProt、KEGG）
copy.tagline_en: Unify queries and analysis across multiple bioinformatics databases

howto.what: Claude可利用BioServices统一访问40多个生物数据库，进行蛋白质分析、通路发现、化合物搜索、序列比对和标识符映射。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行跨多个数据库的查询或分析，或需要在不同数据库之间转换标识符时触发。

say.text: 查找人类ZAP70蛋白的UniProt序列和功能注释。
say.note: 返回该蛋白的FASTA序列及注释。

say.text: 找出KEGG中与B细胞信号通路相关的所有基因。
say.note: 返回通路ID及包含的基因。

say.text: 将UniProt ID P43403转换为KEGG ID。

howto.what_en: Claude can use BioServices to uniformly access over 40 bioinformatics databases (e.g., UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL) for protein analysis, pathway discovery, compound searching, sequence alignment, and identifier mapping.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests cross-database queries or analyses, or needs to convert identifiers between databases.

say_en.text: Find human ZAP70 protein's UniProt sequence and annotation.
Find all genes involved in B cell signaling pathway in KEGG.
Convert UniProt ID P43403 to KEGG ID.
